:::{#def-power-integer}
#### Powers with exponent zero or a negative integer

For the [exponent](#def-power-exponent) $0$ and negative [integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers) [exponents](#def-power-exponent):

- $a^0 \eqdef 1$, including $0^0 = 1$ by convention;
- $a^{-n} \eqdef \frac{1}{a^n}$, when $a \ne 0$.

:::
